avt.name: AVT
avt.citation: From the Aortic Vessel Tree (AVT) collection, Radl et al., 2022, which builds on the RIDER Lung CT collection from The Cancer Imaging Archive. Cropped, averaged into 2 mm slices, and reduced to the HU range the viewer shows.

scans.title: Real CT: aneurysm with thrombus
scans.blurb: A real, deidentified CTA of an infrarenal aneurysm, from an openly licensed collection. Measure it the same way as the phantoms.
scans.debrief: This one is a person, not a phantom. The neck comes off below the renals and widens into an aneurysm with a crescent of thrombus at the back, and the common iliacs run long before the internal iliacs come off. Real anatomy doesn't line up with the slices, so the neck you mark and the diameters you take are judgement calls in a way the phantom's never were.
